units.passage: In short, a uniform Institute-wide rule would inevitably be too permissive for some contexts and too restrictive for others.
units.why: 'a uniform Institute-wide rule would inevitably be too permissive for some contexts and too restrictive for others' explains why the Institute does not set one rule (P04).

units.passage: Departments are a natural unit for this work, since students experience a major as a coherent progression and would benefit from consistency about when AI is welcomed, when it is restricted, and why.
units.why: 'Departments are a natural unit for this work' places AI-policy consistency at the department level (P04).

units.passage: While we recommend against imposing a one-size-fits-all policy on AI use, students are anxious for clarity about AI use: in any given course, they want to feel sure about when, where, and why AI is prohibited, allowed, or required.
units.why: 'we recommend against imposing a one-size-fits-all policy on AI use' recommends that the Institute not set one rule and leave it to instructors and departments: P04, with modality should-not.

units.passage: Depart- ments will likely want to take a coordinated approach so that guidelines and rationales are well understood and largely consistent across a given major.

units.passage: Their responsibilities could include shaping tailored AI policies, planning how to adapt each unit's course offerings in light of AI, and developing new unit-level education and assessment models such as competency-based learning, portfolios, or both.
units.why: AI Leads' duties include 'shaping tailored AI policies', locating policy at school or department level (P04).

units.passage: For Fall 2026, as in previous years, there are no Institute-wide requirements for setting policies on AI use in classes.

units.passage: Recognizing both the diverse potential benefits and challenges of generative AI across academic areas, instructors have the discretion to set their own policies for the application of these AI tools in their courses. Such guidelines should be detailed in the course syllabi and clearly conveyed to students.
units.why: The sentence gives each instructor "the discretion to set their own policies", so the university sets no single rule and delegates; this is actor instructor, phase before-course (policy design), modality may, type P04 (per-instructor rule).
